first_use_shared_suite_primary.classification: Async first-use shared-suite primary measurement; not interchangeable with separately warmed native matrix or selected sync profile
first_use_shared_suite_primary.cause_of_ttft_difference: unresolved; compilation, capture, scheduling, and process-history contributions are not isolated by these two artifacts
first_use_shared_suite_primary.comparison_policy: Preserve both raw results; do not substitute warmed result for official suite measurement or present difference as an isolated code speedup

selected_sync_shared_suite_primary.classification: No-warmup first request following qualitative state changes; the installed native CLI explicitly skips its optional readiness request. This is not the warmed target statistic.
selected_sync_shared_suite_primary.attribution_limit: First-use/capture costs are consistent with the lifecycle, but exact phase costs were not measured and detailed request ITL arrays were not saved by this shared-suite invocation.

serving_burst.scheduler_tradeoff: Versus optimized async, TTFT falls but first-decode capture moves into ITL; meanE2EL is0.40% higher and output throughput0.39% lower. Not a uniform occupancy gain.
serving_burst.limitation: --warm-occupancy warms a full occupancy-matched request burst (8 or 32 requests), repeating prompt0. General B>1 prefill invalidates the decode trace each burst, so measured decode capture is recurring general-path work, not merely unwarmed larger-occupancy first-use overhead. Repeated prompt0 does not warm every measured prompt.
